runners_data.name: Roy Lane
runners_data.comment: Modest recent form reads 6th, unplaced and 6th, leaving him winless in his last three starts. Back within 28 days and proven over today's five furlongs, he's fifth of eight on our figures from draw 2 — thin claims on this evidence.

runners_data.name: Jack Rabbit Slims
runners_data.comment: A frame regular without a win so far, with a second last time out and further frame efforts in his last six starts. Fit again 21 days on and proven at today's trip, he tops the field on our figures at 68.

runners_data.name: Country Artiste
runners_data.comment: Form has faded across her last five starts, sliding from 5th and 6th through to 9th last time out. Race fit 13 days on and proven at today's trip, she's second of eight on our figures at 65 despite that recent dip.

runners_data.name: Dabbling
runners_data.comment: Form has trended the right way, improving from 9th through to a 4th last time out across her last five starts, though still winless. Fit again 21 days on and proven at today's trip, she's third of eight on our figures.

runners_data.name: Our Hero Matty
runners_data.comment: A third last time out was clearly his best of the last five starts, following two unplaced efforts in between. Fit again 22 days on and proven at today's trip, he's fourth of eight on our figures.

runners_data.name: What A Tahoo
runners_data.comment: A win two starts back is the highlight of a modest sequence that also shows three placed efforts and a 5th last time out. Race fit 14 days on and proven at today's trip, she's second-bottom of the field on our figures at 52.

runners_data.name: Power Of Chora
runners_data.comment: A modest sequence of 8th, 6th, 6th and 8th was lifted by a third last time out, her best effort of the last five starts. Fit again 21 days on and proven at today's trip, she's sixth of eight on our figures.

runners_data.name: Sparkling Wine
runners_data.comment: A second two starts back stands out from an otherwise workmanlike sequence across her last five starts. Fit again 21 days on and proven at today's trip, she's bottom of the field on our figures at 50 — needs more to get competitive.

races.name: Malcolm Greenslade Doncaster LVA Stalwart Memorial Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: It's Debatable
runners_data.comment: A close second last time out was the highlight of a modest three-run sequence, and the yard is in form on a 31% strike rate over the last fortnight. Race fit 19 days on and proven at today's trip, he's third of four on our figures.

runners_data.name: Mandarin Spirit
runners_data.comment: A win and a narrow second bookend a fair spell of form earlier in the year, though the last two starts have dropped away sharply. A 44-day gap since her latest outing is the query, even with a figure of 87 second only to the selection.

runners_data.name: Pendella
runners_data.comment: A notably consistent sequence — a win five starts back and only one finish outside the frame in six runs — has her top of this field on our figures at 88. Proven at today's trip, the 38-day layoff since her last run is the only obvious blot.

runners_data.name: Tamzan
runners_data.comment: Won last time out, backing that up on an unchanged mark of 73, fresh off a quick 21-day turnaround and proven at today's trip. Rated bottom of this quartet on our figures, though, meaning she needs to find more to trouble the trio above her.

runners_data.name: Lever Up
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts but working into form, with a third last time out and a brace of fourths further back. Back after a 46-day break and proven at today's trip, he tops this nine on our figures at 71.

runners_data.name: Dr Rio
runners_data.comment: Ability was evident with a third three starts back, though the last two efforts have dropped away. Back within 11 days of his latest outing and proven at today's trip, he's fourth of nine on our figures at 64.

runners_data.name: Sunny Orange
runners_data.comment: A largely consistent frame-filler, with three 4ths, a 7th, an unplaced effort and a 3rd across his last six starts, though winless throughout. Quick to reappear just 11 days on, he's sixth of nine on our figures.

runners_data.name: Kitsune Power
runners_data.comment: A run of frame finishes earlier — including a second three starts back — has given way to a poor last two. Proven at today's trip and back 18 days on, he is third of nine on our figures; the question is whether he rediscovers that level.

runners_data.name: Star Start
runners_data.comment: A mixed sequence for this middle-order sort, ranging from a 9th to a 3rd across his last five starts. Fit again 15 days on and proven at today's trip, he's fifth of nine on our figures — capable of another mid-pack finish.

runners_data.name: Bradbury
runners_data.comment: Rattled off back-to-back wins in his last two starts, following a pair of seconds before that. The yard is in form too, at a 31% strike rate over the last fortnight, and he's second of nine on our figures despite the 29-day gap since his latest run.

runners_data.name: Melting Snow
runners_data.comment: A workmanlike run of 6th, 5th and 8th across her last three starts leaves her marked down by our figures to 48, well below her official mark of 62. Fit again 28 days on, she needs a big reversal to feature from second-bottom of this nine.

runners_data.name: Wicklow Way
runners_data.comment: A win five starts back is the standout feature of an otherwise mixed sequence that also includes two 9ths. A third last time out was more encouraging, and he's proven at today's trip — seventh of nine on our figures.

runners_data.name: Mavetheforcebewivu
runners_data.comment: A second two starts back is the highlight of a modest sequence otherwise well off the pace. Fit again 19 days on, she's bottom of this nine on our figures at 39 — needs plenty of improvement to be competitive.

runners_data.name: Without Flaw
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in her last five starts, with a third-placed effort four runs back the best of a workaday sequence either side. Proven over today's trip and rated top of ten on our figures, the clear advantage in the figures makes her the one to beat, despite the modest finishing positions.

runners_data.name: He's An Angel
runners_data.comment: Three moderate efforts down the field preceded a breakthrough win three starts back, and the improvement continued when runner-up next time out, though he dropped away again in eighth most recently. Proven over today's trip and rated third of ten on our figures, that win-and-place sequence makes him a threat if the improved form resurfaces.

runners_data.name: Opal Storm
runners_data.comment: A win three starts back followed two modest efforts, including a well-beaten ninth, but the form has since cooled with finishes of fifth and unplaced in the two runs since. She returns from a lengthy 72-day break, and though proven over today's trip and rated fourth of ten on our figures, that spell on the sidelines leaves fitness as the obvious question mark.

runners_data.name: Barmyblade
runners_data.comment: Won last time out having also finished runner-up two starts back, a clear improving trend after modest form before that. Proven over today's trip and quick to return just 13 days later, that progressive shape makes him our pick even without matching the very best figure in the race — the modest form further back the only blot.

runners_data.name: Golden Prosperity
runners_data.comment: Third last time out continues an upward trend, following finishes of fourth and fifth in the two runs before. Yet to win in his last six starts, but proven over today's trip and rated fifth of ten on our figures, there's enough here to play a competitive part.

runners_data.name: Crafty Spirit
runners_data.comment: Won last time out, and runner-up the start before, continuing an upward turn after one-paced efforts further back. Proven over today's trip and rated sixth of ten on our figures, the recent upturn is encouraging even with a month since that latest win.

runners_data.name: So Grateful
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, with a fourth-placed effort last time out the highlight of a modest sequence that has otherwise brought finishes no better than seventh. Proven over today's trip and quick to return just 8 days later, that fast turnaround and improved last run offer a little encouragement, rated seventh of ten on our figures.

runners_data.name: Pinpoint
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, though a runner-up finish last time out is a definite step forward after a run of modest form. Proven over today's trip but rated ninth of ten on our figures, he has plenty to find against a field largely rated above him.

runners_data.name: Invincible Annice
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in her last five starts, with finishes no better than sixth and a spell down the field including a cluster of finishes eighth or worse. Proven over today's trip and rated eighth of ten on our figures, there's little in this sequence to suggest a change of fortune is imminent.

runners_data.name: Ziva's Star
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in her last five starts, with a third-placed effort two runs back the clear high point among finishes no better than seventh elsewhere. Proven over today's trip but rated bottom of ten on our figures, she needs a career-best to get involved in this company.

races.name: Racing Again On Monday Evening Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Thornaby Annie
runners_data.comment: A winner two starts back, with runner-up efforts on the two starts before that, and a below-par seventh last time out. Proven over today's distance and rated second of eight on our figures, she is a leading threat if that better form resurfaces.

runners_data.name: Dumfries
runners_data.comment: A win is on the card but it came five starts back, with the four runs since no better than fourth. Proven over today's trip, he returns from a lengthy 271-day absence rated sixth of eight on our figures — fitness after that time off is the key question.

runners_data.name: Viviana
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in her last four starts, but two thirds feature among them, with finishes of sixth and fifth in the two runs since. Proven over today's trip and rated fifth of eight on our figures, the earlier placed form is encouraging even though the recent dip needs reversing.

runners_data.name: The Sweet Escape
runners_data.comment: Won last time out to end a run of one-paced efforts, returning quickly just 11 days later. Proven over today's trip and rated third of eight on our figures, he's a leading threat if that improved form holds — the finishes before that win were modest.

runners_data.name: Shahik
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, with no frame finish in that time, but a rating of 79 stands clear of this field on our figures. Proven over today's trip and quick to return 12 days on, that clear margin makes him the one to beat despite modest recent finishes.

runners_data.name: Solar Cooper
runners_data.comment: Won three starts back but the two runs since have been modest, sandwiched between a spell of low finishes either side. Proven over today's trip and rated fourth of eight on our figures, a return to that form would make him competitive, but the recent decline is the concern.

runners_data.name: Secretinthesky
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in her last four starts, the pick a fourth four starts back. Since then an eighth and a fifth, then an unplaced effort last time out. Proven over today's trip, she is rated bottom of eight on our figures and needs more to be involved.

runners_data.name: Enjoy The Night
runners_data.comment: Yet to win in his last five starts, with finishes no better than fifth across the sequence and a well-beaten ninth among them. Rated seventh of eight on our figures, there is little in the recent form to inspire confidence here.
